title: If Only I Could Have The Good
summary: Loneliness is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: If only I could have the good fortune to meet some friendly Saint
lifeApplication: Name the companionship the line is restoring before the mind insists it is alone. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
